name:
Fraksi Karya Pembangunan
(DPP Slipi - Akbar)
summary:
Under the shrewd stewardship of Akbar Tandjung at the party's DPP Slipi headquarters, this wing of Golkar represents the entrenched political machinery inherited wholesale from the New Order: the provincial governors, regency bosses, career bureaucrats, and patronage networks that delivered six consecutive stage-managed elections over thirty-two years and are now scrambling to survive inside a multiparty system none of them ever wanted. For decades, the Banyan Tree served as the civilian arm of an authoritarian organicist state, enforcing bureaucratic monoloyalty from the ministries down to the village hall. Taking 22.4% of the national vote in June—a bruising but survivable second-place finish behind PDI-P—is treated privately by Akbar as vindication that his cautious rebranding saved the party from the outright ban that street demonstrators were demanding barely a year ago.

Unlike your outer-island and ICMI loyalists, Akbar's Slipi machine feels no personal debt to you whatsoever. Their loyalty runs strictly to the party apparatus itself: to preserving its hold over state enterprises, shielding its regional treasurers from KKN prosecutions, and securing a seat at whatever coalition table forms after October. You are, in their calculation, merely the current occupant of an office Golkar needs to remain adjacent to for as long as it pays dividends. A stable macroeconomy, insulated patronage channels, and a credible path to keeping the party in power speak far louder to these seasoned operators than any sermon on democratic reform. If backroom vote-counting convinces the provincial chairmen that your presidency has become a sinking ship, Akbar will pivot the machine toward a more viable horse without a second thought.
biography:
A consummate political survivor who cut his teeth leading the Islamic Students' Association (HMI) during the 1966 student uprising, Djandji Akbar Zahiruddin Tandjung helped found the youth coalition KNPI, joined Golkar in 1974, and entered the DPR in 1977. Suharto rewarded his quiet organizational discipline with consecutive cabinet portfolios—Minister of Youth and Sports from 1988 to 1993, then Minister of Public Housing from 1993 until the regime's collapse in May 1998. You brought him into your own cabinet as Minister/State Secretary, and at Golkar's tumultuous July 1998 Extraordinary Congress, with the party reeling from public fury and facing demands for its dissolution, your allies backed Akbar to defeat retired General Edi Sudradjat for the party chairmanship.

Operating out of Slipi, he repackaged the party around a 'New Golkar' paradigm, shedding just enough New Order & Jalan Cendana baggage to hold onto its rural and outer-island bastions in the June 1999 ballot. Beneath his polite, softly spoken demeanor sits one of the most calculating parliamentarians in Senayan. He harbors no deep ideological attachment to you or to your reform agenda; his overriding objective is ensuring Golkar remains the indispensable kingmaker of Indonesian politics, even if that requires trading away your presidency behind the secret-ballot curtain when the MPR General Session convenes.

interactions.text: Assure the party's regional chairmen that traditional patronage arrangements will continue uninterrupted
interactions.description: For three decades, holding a Golkar provincial chairmanship came bundled with privileged access to public works tenders, forestry concessions, and regional bank credit—an ecosystem so entrenched that most local party bosses consider it the natural order of governance. Send word through DPP Slipi's internal couriers that your administration has no intention of turning off the spigot. This will severely damage your Reformasi credibility and anger opposition parties. Grants 1 Favor with Golkar (Akbar).
interactions.alertMsg: Akbar Tandjung receives the assurance with quiet satisfaction, and Golkar's provincial chairmen fall back into line almost immediately. The reformist press—whose reporters spent 1998 marching to abolish these exact networks—treats the leak as proof that KKN has merely changed its letterhead.

interactions.text: Subtly remind Slipi's leadership of the sensitive financial dossiers sitting on your desk
interactions.description: The unredacted PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) forensic trail on the Bank Bali transfer—alongside Attorney General's Office files implicating Golkar's deputy treasurer and off-budget campaign accounts—have not gone anywhere. Let Akbar Tandjung understand, without anything so crude as an explicit threat, that Palace discretion over which files remain sealed depends on his caucus's discipline.
interactions.alertMsg: The message lands in Slipi exactly as intended. Akbar's lieutenants dial back their public criticism overnight, and the Cendana-linked operators most exposed by the audit quietly distance themselves from opposition Whip counts.

interactions.text: Throw Bina Graha's weight behind Akbar Tandjung's continued chairmanship of the party
interactions.description: Golkar's internal hierarchy remains brittle beneath the surface, with outer-island Irama Tersedak loyalists openly agitating to unseat Akbar Tandjung before the General Session. Signal through Bina Graha channels that the Palace recognizes Akbar's control over the central party board, trading away your own loyalists' ambitions to buy peace with the Slipi machine. Disappoints Loyalist Golkar delegates.
interactions.alertMsg: Word from the Palace steadies Akbar's grip over the central board and quiets talk of an extraordinary party coup. Your own Sulawesi and ICMI loyalists, however, are bitter that you strengthened the very faction leader most likely to betray you.

interactions.text: Distribute state-owned enterprise (BUMN) board seats to Golkar's provincial powerbrokers
interactions.description: The supervisory boards of Indonesia's largest State-Owned Enterprises (BUMN)—from Pertamina and Telkom to state banks still on BLBI life support—have lucrative commissioner vacancies. Fill a slate of them with nominees Akbar Tandjung's provincial chairmen have been quietly submitting for months. Undermines Economic Health and Reformasi Credibility. Grants 1 Favor with Golkar (Akbar).
interactions.alertMsg: The commissioner decrees are signed without fanfare, and Golkar's regional barons treat the sinecures as proof that the old spoils system still works. Market analysts and IMF monitors, watching party operatives installed atop fragile state corporations, are far less forgiving.

interactions.text: Stall the unredacted PricewaterhouseCoopers Bank Bali report before it reaches the DPR
interactions.description: The full PwC forensic audit into the Rp 546 billion Bank Bali fee names senior Golkar treasurers and campaign operators whom DPP Slipi is desperate to keep out of televised parliamentary hearings. Use procedural reviews at the Supreme Audit Agency (BPK) to hold back the unredacted annex. Permanently locks out handing the unredacted files to PDI-P's Pansus committee. Grants 1 Favor with Golkar (Akbar).
interactions.alertMsg: The procedural bottleneck buys Golkar's treasury the breathing room it craved, and Akbar makes sure the debt is noted in Slipi. PDI-P's investigators erupt over the cover-up, and foreign creditors warn that obstructing the audit jeopardizes future bailout tranches.

interactions.text: Press Golkar's National Leadership Meeting (Rapimnas) to ratify you as its sole candidate
interactions.description: Several provincial chapters inside Akbar Tandjung's camp have floated nominating Akbar himself—or even General Wiranto—should your poll numbers falter. Demand that the party's Rapimnas formally bind all 120 DPR delegates to your candidacy now, locking the Banyan Tree's institutional prestige to your survival before rival brokers can split the caucus. Grants 1 Favor with Golkar (Akbar).
interactions.alertMsg: After marathon backroom bargaining at Slipi, the Rapimnas formally ratifies you as Golkar's sole presidential nominee. Your loyalists celebrate the resolution as decisive institutional cover, even if Akbar's lieutenants keep their options open in private.

interactions.text: Summon Akbar Tandjung on the eve of the roll call and demand the Slipi machine hold the line
interactions.description: Every BUMN board seat, every shielded audit file, and every quiet concession you have extended to DPP Slipi over the past four months comes down to tonight's secret ballot in Senayan. Summon Akbar Tandjung face-to-face and demand he enforce strict party discipline over his 80 delegates when the roll is called. Automatically cashes in any unspent Favors with Golkar (Akbar) for a massive loyalty surge.
interactions.alertMsg: Akbar Tandjung offers the practiced, solemn reassurance of a lifelong machine politician—promising to work the floor until dawn while betraying nothing of what he has privately discussed with Amien Rais and Gus Dur.
